description: Validation test suite for LangGraph State & Persistence technology skill covering all 16 required scenarios

testCases.description: Typed state contract using TypedDict with NotRequired for fields populated downstream

expected.notes: State schema correctly specifies required startup keys and optional downstream keys

testCases.description: Correct list accumulation reducer with Annotated[list, operator.add]

expected.notes: Reducer properly accumulates items across multiple node execution steps

testCases.description: Safe partial dictionary returns from nodes without in-place shared state mutation

expected.notes: Node returns new state dictionary without mutating inputs

testCases.description: Destructive in-place mutation of shared state list causing lost updates and tracking bugs

defects.recommendation: Return partial dictionaries with updated state rather than mutating shared state lists in-place.

testCases.description: Parallel fan-out branches writing to same state key without an Annotated reducer

defects.recommendation: Declare Annotated reducer on state channel to resolve concurrent branch writes.

expected.notes: Conflicting write in parallel branches detected

testCases.description: Durable checkpointing configuration with Postgres checkpointer for multi-turn execution

expected.notes: Durable checkpointer properly wired for multi-turn execution

testCases.description: Thread ID used as sole authorization check without tenant ownership verification

defects.recommendation: Verify user/tenant ownership before retrieving or restoring checkpointed state.

expected.notes: Missing authorization check on thread access detected

testCases.description: Multi-replica production deployment using ephemeral MemorySaver instead of durable checkpointer

defects.recommendation: Use durable checkpointer (PostgresSaver/RedisSaver) for multi-replica production environments.

expected.notes: Ephemeral checkpointer in production deployment detected

testCases.description: Plaintext secret or API key stored directly in graph state channel

defects.recommendation: Never store credentials or API keys in graph state; pass via execution configuration.

expected.notes: Sensitive credentials in state channel detected

testCases.description: Large raw binary payload stored in state rather than object reference URI

defects.recommendation: Store external object storage URIs or references instead of raw binary files in graph state.

expected.notes: Bloated state payload with raw binary bytes detected

testCases.description: Non-idempotent external payment side effect repeated during node failure recovery

defects.recommendation: Use idempotency keys derived from thread ID and step count for external side effects during recovery.

expected.notes: Non-idempotent side effect in recoverable node detected

testCases.description: Schema evolution adding required field without default breaking legacy persisted checkpoints

defects.recommendation: New fields in durable state schemas must be optional or provide defaults for legacy checkpoint compatibility.

testCases.description: Valid ephemeral single-turn workflow intentionally omitting checkpointer (false-positive prevention)

expected.notes: Ephemeral single-turn workflow does not require checkpointer

testCases.description: Valid state channel using direct overwrite without reducer for scalar field (false-positive prevention)

expected.notes: Scalar channel intentionally uses direct replacement/overwrite

testCases.description: Insufficient evidence regarding custom checkpointer backend leading to uncertainty recording

expected.notes: Custom checkpointer implementation is external and cannot be verified statically

testCases.description: Consolidation of multiple state serialization errors into single root-cause finding

defects.recommendation: Consolidate duplicate serialization symptoms into single root-cause finding.
